Today (October 26, New Calendar) the Church keeps the feast of the Holy Greatmartyr Demetrius of Thessalonica.

Born of a noble family in Thessalonica, Demetrius commanded the Roman forces in Thessaly, yet put his faith in Christ before every worldly honor and brought many to the faith.

Under the Emperor Maximian he was imprisoned and killed with spears in his cell, in the year 306. Fragrant myrrh flowed from his body and healed many of the sick, and for centuries he has been the patron saint of Thessalonica.

Holy Great-martyr Demetrius, pray to God for us.
